sources.quote: HD 191939 is a single yellow (G-type) main-sequence star, located approximately 174 light-years away in the northern constellation of Draco, taking its primary name from its Henry Draper Catalogue designation.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Lubin et al. 2022.
